author: Claude (handoff 116)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any live RPC request is made and before the worker exists.
purpose: Freeze the evidence rules, the provability determination, the rate and stopping policy, and the record schemas for a read-only selective backfill of B15a decoded launch transactions.

provability_determination.note: Settled OFFLINE from the pinned IDL and the project's own derivation, before any transaction was fetched. Fetching first and deciding afterwards is how a rule gets chosen to match what the data happened to allow.

real_quote.provable_when: the launch transaction carries at least one TradeEvent on this curve
real_quote.derivation: real_quote_reserves of the LAST TradeEvent on this curve in canonical (slot, transaction_index, outer_index, inner_index) order within the transaction
real_quote.evidence: TradeEvent publishes real_sol_reserves and real_quote_reserves; CreateEvent publishes neither
real_quote.unprovable_when: the launch transaction carries no TradeEvent on this curve
real_quote.why_not_zero: a freshly created curve very probably holds no quote, but 'very probably' is an assumption and the freeze forbids assumptions. Post-balances would require knowing the rent-exempt minimum to subtract, which is a second assumption.

complete.derivation: b10b_path_dataset.is_complete_at applied with completions scanned WITHIN the launch transaction: a CompleteEvent for this curve at or before t0 makes it true, absence makes it false
complete.why_absence_is_proof_here: the curve is CREATED in this transaction, so no earlier transaction could have completed it. Absence of a CompleteEvent in the only transaction that could contain one is evidence, not an assumption. This is the project's own rule, not a new one.
complete.unprovable_when: two CompleteEvents for one curve appear, which b10b already refuses as impossible

provability_determination.consequence: Backfill unlocks t0 state exactly for launches whose transaction carries a trade — in B11b's vocabulary, those with a creator initial buy. Launches with no trade in the launch transaction keep a no-entry decision with U01, permanently and correctly.

transport.credential: environment only; never an argument, never written to any artifact

rate_and_stopping_policy.rate_justification: conservative and fixed before any throughput was observed, so it cannot have been tuned up after seeing that the endpoint tolerated more. One request at a time keeps ordering and retry accounting simple enough to audit.
rate_and_stopping_policy.stopping_rule: a run ends when the pending set is exhausted, when max_requests_per_run is reached, or on an explicit operator stop

may_not_write: every file in the B11c integrity manifest
isolation.concurrency: B15a keeps recording while this runs. B15a is opened read-only and never written, so an append-only recorder and a read-only reader cannot conflict.

rpc_exchange.storage: append-only JSONL; a line once written is never edited or deleted

t0_state.note: every field derived only from events inside the launch transaction, decoded with the pinned IDL through the shared decoder

decision_v2.history_rule: a feed-only decision is NEVER rewritten. A backfilled decision is a new row at version 2 naming the row it supersedes, and exactly one decision is CURRENT per decoded launch.

failure_rules.condition: the response's transaction signature is not the one requested
the response's slot disagrees with the slot B15a recorded
the CreateEvent in the response names a different mint than B15a recorded
the transaction carries an error; a failed transaction launched nothing
the response carries no CreateEvent for this curve
two CreateEvents for one curve, or two CompleteEvents, in one transaction
the response's context slot precedes the launch slot
the artifact could not be written
an event on this curve does not decode under the pinned IDL

failure_rule: every one of these FAILS VISIBLY: the exchange is preserved, the backfill row records the code, and the decision is not advanced. None is downgraded to a warning and none produces a partial state.

unavailable_reasons.meaning: no TradeEvent in the launch transaction, so real_quote is not published by any event in it
the bounded retries were used without a response
fee, priority fee, tip or latency were not supplied by the caller, so an executable entry cannot be priced

policy_on_backfilled_state.vetoes: B11b's own evaluate_vetoes, called unchanged on the rematerialized t0 state
policy_on_backfilled_state.simulated_entry: B10a's own pricing, on the rematerialized state, only when every input it requires is present

cost_inputs.rule: fee, priority fee, tip and latency must be CALLER-STATED or the entry is unavailable
cost_inputs.reason: a default cost is a number nobody measured standing where a measurement belongs, and it flatters every figure computed downstream

policy_on_backfilled_state.no_profit_published: exits and outcomes are a later shadow stage; this preregistration publishes no realised figure and no profit

idempotence.rule: re-running the worker over the same signatures must produce the same rows and no duplicates
idempotence.key: signature is unique in the backfill table; the rpc_exchange log is append-only and grows

strictly_forbidden: wallet or key material of any kind
tips, priority fees, or any spending
altering or restarting the B15a recorder or the B11c watcher
assuming a value for any field the evidence does not publish
reading state later than the launch transaction
using a terminal or current snapshot in place of point-in-time evidence
publishing any profit, executable or live claim
